subject: Medford Teachers Association MOA
overview: The School Committee convened to consider and approve a Memorandum of Agreement with the Medford Teachers Association governing working conditions for the 2020–2021 school year. The committee approved the agreement by a 7-0 vote in executive session.

items.title: MTA Working Conditions MOA Approval
items.summary: The committee approved a Memorandum of Agreement with the Medford Teachers Association for the 2020–2021 school year, establishing health protocols, mandatory COVID-19 testing, and air quality standards.

items.title: Upcoming Meeting Announcements
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn outlined upcoming committee meeting schedules and noted that the Columbus School renaming will be scheduled for discussion in March.
